# Luxtile Installations

> Supplier and installer of premium large format porcelain slabs and luxury tiles in Johannesburg, Sandton, Pretoria and across South Africa.

Luxtile Installations specialises in large format porcelain slabs up to 1600x3200mm for floors, walls, kitchens, bathrooms, countertops and feature walls in luxury residential, hospitality and commercial projects. Services include slab supply, precision cutting, mitre and bevel finishing, nationwide delivery and expert specification guidance for architects, designers and developers.
